Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:175887
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40952 of 2024
Applicant :- Somwati @ Ramshri

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravi Shankar Tripathi,Shyam Babu
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.
2. Heard Sri Ravi Shankar Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jamman Ram, learned AGA, for the State.

3. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
260 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Dataganj, District Budaun, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother in law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture she has been made accused in the present case alongwith other family members including her son i.e. husband of the deceased.
Somwati @ Ramshri vs State Of U.P. on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97447646/
1 5.

entities.text: Somwati @ Ramshri vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He next submitted that being mother in law of deceased, applicant was not having any concern with family affairs of deceased and it reflects that some dispute arose between husband and wife and thereafter wife consumed insecticide and died.

6. He further submitted that during post-mortem, however, cause of death could not be ascertained but from viscera report it reflects that due to consumption of insecticide, deceased died and details of viscera report noted in the case diary has been annexed along with the instant bail application..
7. He further submitted that it is a case of suicidal death.
8.

He further submitted, however, at the time of Inquest, informant was present and he was one of the inquest witness but in spite of that he lodged the FIR on 25.06.2024 i.e., after about twenty days and this fact shows that after due consultation on the basis of false allegation, the FIR of the present case was lodged.
9.
He further submits that applicant is a lady and there is no specific allegation against her and she is having no criminal history and in the present matter, she is in jail since 13.09.2024.

10. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother in law of deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and considering the viscera report, at this stage, it cannot be said that it is not a case of suicidal death.
11.
Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that informant was one of the witnesses of the inquest but in spite of that FIR was lodged after about twenty days.
12. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

13. Applicant is mother in law of deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and FIR of the present case was lodged after about twenty days and from viscera report, it could not be reflected that it is not a case of suicidal death.
14.
Further, applicant is a lady and she is having no criminal history and in the present matter, she is in jail since 13.09.2024.

15. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
16. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

17. Let the applicant-Somwati @ Ramshri, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
Somwati @ Ramshri vs State Of U.P. on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97447646/

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
18. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

19. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
